provenance.name: Individual Household Electric Power Consumption (UCI)
provenance.citation: Hebrail, G., & Berard, A. (2006). Individual Household Electric Power Consumption [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C58K54
provenance.notes: One household in Sceaux, France, sampled every minute from December 2006 to November 2010.

split.embargo: 24 h horizon; no lag shorter than the horizon
split.notes: Hours with no recorded load are neither trained on nor scored.

models.name: Four-week hourly average
models.notes: Mean of the same hour over the previous four weeks.

models.name: Ridge + residual quantiles
models.notes: Imputer and scaler fitted per fold inside the pipeline.

models.name: LightGBM quantile
models.notes: Three boosters on the pinball objective.

models.name: Four-week average + Student-t
models.notes: Four-week mean with a t(4) interval scaled by last week's variability.

runtime_assertions.name: assert_lags_respect_horizon
runtime_assertions.detail: 8 lags checked against a 24-hour horizon; shortest is 24 hours; 0 shorter than the horizon.

runtime_assertions.name: assert_no_lookahead
runtime_assertions.detail: 600 feature values across 30 target hours recomputed from data available at the forecast origin; 0 differed.

runtime_assertions.name: assert_temporal_split
runtime_assertions.detail: Last training timestamp 2007-12-16 17:00:00 precedes first test timestamp 2007-12-16 18:00:00 by 0 days 01:00:00; no embargo required.

runtime_assertions.name: assert_no_target_leak
runtime_assertions.detail: 20 numeric features correlated against the target; strongest was same_hour_4wk_mean at |r|=0.5275 (threshold 0.995).
